# Interoperable Europe Portal

> EU platform enabling digital interoperability across public administrations, businesses, and member states through standards, reference architectures, and regulatory frameworks.

The Interoperable Europe Portal is the European Commission's central hub for promoting semantic and technical interoperability in digital government. It provides access to reference architectures (EIRA), open source solutions, regulatory sandboxes, and community support for implementing the Interoperable Europe Act and European Interoperability Framework.

## Key Topics

- Interoperable Europe Act
- European Interoperability Reference Architecture (EIRA)
- Digital public services
- Cross-border interoperability
- SEMIC (Semantic Interoperability Community)
- Open source solutions
- Regulatory sandboxes
- DCAT-AP (Data Catalog Vocabulary)
- EU GovTech
- Open Source Observatory (OSOR)
- European Interoperability Framework
- Digital transformation
- Data spaces
- Public administration
- Semantic standards

## Core Platform & Initiative

- [Interoperable Europe Portal](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu): EU platform for promoting interoperability across public administrations and businesses
- [Interoperable Europe](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/interoperable-europe): Main about page covering Interoperable Europe initiative and European Commission governance
- [Interoperable Europe Act](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/interoperable-europe/interoperable-europe-act): Reference page for Interoperable Europe Act legislation and regulatory framework

## Solutions & Catalogs

- [Solutions](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/interoperable_solutions): Solutions catalog and domain browsing for interoperable digital services
- [Interoperable Europe Solutions](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/interoperable-europe-solutions): Interoperable Europe Solutions using DCAT-AP and semantic interoperability standards
- [Interoperability Solutions](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/other_solutions): EU digital services and reusable components including CIRCABC and e-CODEX
- [EU Open Source Solutions Catalogue](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/eu-oss-catalogue): Open source solutions catalog for public administration digital government

## Reference Architecture & Standards

- [Interoperability Architecture Solutions (EIRA)](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/collection/european-interoperability-reference-architecture-eira): EIRA reference architecture for digital public services and cross-border integration
- [IOPEU Monitoring](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/collection/iopeu-monitoring): Monitoring observatory for Interoperable Europe Act and European Interoperability Framework
- [SEMIC Support Centre](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/collection/semic-support-centre): SEMIC support for semantic standards, DCAT-AP, and data spaces

## Support & Learning

- [Interoperable Europe Support Centre](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/interoperable-europe-support-centre): Support center for SEMIC and European Interoperability Reference Architecture (EIRA)
- [FAQs](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/interoperable-europe/faqs): FAQs on Interoperable Europe Act, digital services, and cross-border interoperability
- [Portal Support](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/collection/portal-support): Portal user guide, getting started, and community discussion support
- [Community Forum](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/discussions): Community forum for EUPL licensing and interoperability discussions

## Governance & Innovation

- [Events](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/interoperable-europe/events): Events calendar including SEMIC 2025, ENDORSE, and Interoperable Europe Academy
- [EU GovTech](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/collection/eugovtech): EU GovTech initiatives, startup ecosystem, and SME directory for government technology
- [Interoperability Regulatory Sandboxes](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/collection/interoperability-regulatory-sandboxes): Regulatory sandboxes for cross-border data sharing and innovation testing
- [Digital-ready Policymaking](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/collection/digital-ready-policymaking): Digital-ready Policymaking community platform for regulatory reform and governance

## Knowledge & Community

- [Open Source Observatory (OSOR)](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/collection/open-source-observatory-osor): OSOR knowledge center for open source adoption in public administrations
- [Latest News](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/interoperable-europe/latest-news): Latest news and updates on interoperability initiatives and regulatory sandboxes
